cases.query: Keep finite capacity, time, memory, token, output, queue, or retry budgets within an explicit safe envelope. identify-capacity-consumers define-residual-budget enforce-boundary handle-nonpositive-or-exhausted-case validate-boundary-and-cost-oracle

candidate_pool.title: Resolve failure recovery and retry through a contract-first, evidence-validated change chain.
candidate_pool.summary: Resolve failure recovery and retry through a contract-first, evidence-validated change chain.

candidate_pool.title: Reconstruct the correct session-and-route cached value after a route switch or a compression rescue that mutates and then rolls back token state.
candidate_pool.summary: Carry the cached count through route retention/adoption and failed hard-rescue rollback with the rest of the route-scoped token state.

candidate_pool.title: Stop retrying an exhausted model when the upstream supplies no retry schedule, so persistent fallback handling can be reached.
candidate_pool.summary: Add a classifier rule that maps structured model-capacity exhaustion with no server delay to terminal handling, while preserving retryable handling for capacity failures that carry a server delay.

facets.module_role: Structured upstream-failure classifier at the retry and fallback boundary

candidate_pool.title: classify-capacity-exhaustion-before-retry
candidate_pool.summary: When a structured model-capacity failure lacks a server-directed delay, classify it as terminal at the error-normalization boundary so persistent fallback handling is reached without normal retry churn; retain delay-based retry for explicitly delayed capacity failures.

facets.entry_state: A detailed retryable-status API error reaches classification with a model-capacity exhaustion reason and no parsed server retry delay.
facets.exit_state: Capacity exhaustion without a server delay is terminal and eligible for immediate persistent fallback; capacity errors with a server delay remain delay-aware retryable failures.

candidate_pool.title: preserve_foreground_budget_during_cache_keepalive
candidate_pool.summary: For an enabled prompt-cache keepalive flow, isolate the one-token maintenance override from the shared model configuration so delayed cache pings remain bounded and later prefill-capable completions retain their normal output budget.

facets.entry_state: Prompt-cache keepalive is enabled for a cache-capable model; send_message schedules or runs cache warming before the foreground send, and the parent implementation shares the model extra-parameter mapping with the warming request.
facets.exit_state: Each warming request receives max_tokens=1 through a local kwargs copy, the model extra_params mapping remains unchanged for foreground and prefill-capable calls, and the length-continuation path is no longer forced into one-token responses by cache warming.

candidate_pool.summary: Resolve bounded resource budget control through a contract-first, evidence-validated change chain.

candidate_pool.title: Serialize turns that target the same persisted conversation across process boundaries.
candidate_pool.summary: Add a durable per-conversation admission protocol in the shared state database so independent runtimes can coordinate ownership of a turn.

candidate_pool.title: Bound each cache-warming provider request to one output token without permanently reducing the normal completion budget or triggering repeated one-token prefill continuations.
candidate_pool.summary: Create request-local cache-warming kwargs before applying the one-token maintenance cap, preserving the model's configured parameters for subsequent foreground and prefill completions.

facets.module_role: Request-parameter isolation at the boundary between background cache maintenance and foreground model completion.

candidate_pool.title: Make deferred-resource preloading an explicit, mode-aware session budget policy.
candidate_pool.summary: Expose a session-start deferred-tool preload percentage, carry it from user settings into core configuration, default it to 10, and disable the policy in CLI bare/safe modes.

candidate_pool.title: Keep the context breakdown's messages attribution aligned with the active session instead of subtracting another session's cache hit.
candidate_pool.summary: Make context aggregation prefer the active session's cached-content count while retaining a compatibility fallback when no usable chat-local value exists.

candidate_pool.title: Keep active tool, code, file, or similar payloads usable while removing empty text artifacts that can trigger request validation failures.
candidate_pool.summary: Normalize outgoing content parts so an empty text field cannot invalidate a payload-bearing part or remain as a truly empty text-only part.

candidate_pool.title: Remove a stale materialized default from existing configuration files so the new policy takes effect after upgrade without clobbering user-selected resource budgets.
candidate_pool.summary: Migrate configurations that persisted the temporary 256000 default so they inherit the new ratio-only default, without rewriting an intentional cap or explicit null.

facets.module_role: Versioned configuration migration and user-choice preservation

candidate_pool.title: Reconstruct the correct session-and-route cached value after a route switch or a compression rescue that mutates and then rolls back token state.
candidate_pool.summary: Carry the cached count through route retention/adoption and failed hard-rescue rollback with the rest of the route-scoped token state.

candidate_pool.title: Stop retrying an exhausted model when the upstream supplies no retry schedule, so persistent fallback handling can be reached.
candidate_pool.summary: Add a classifier rule that maps structured model-capacity exhaustion with no server delay to terminal handling, while preserving retryable handling for capacity failures that carry a server delay.

facets.module_role: Structured upstream-failure classifier at the retry and fallback boundary

candidate_pool.title: classify-capacity-exhaustion-before-retry
candidate_pool.summary: When a structured model-capacity failure lacks a server-directed delay, classify it as terminal at the error-normalization boundary so persistent fallback handling is reached without normal retry churn; retain delay-based retry for explicitly delayed capacity failures.

facets.entry_state: A detailed retryable-status API error reaches classification with a model-capacity exhaustion reason and no parsed server retry delay.
facets.exit_state: Capacity exhaustion without a server delay is terminal and eligible for immediate persistent fallback; capacity errors with a server delay remain delay-aware retryable failures.

candidate_pool.title: preserve_foreground_budget_during_cache_keepalive
candidate_pool.summary: For an enabled prompt-cache keepalive flow, isolate the one-token maintenance override from the shared model configuration so delayed cache pings remain bounded and later prefill-capable completions retain their normal output budget.

facets.entry_state: Prompt-cache keepalive is enabled for a cache-capable model; send_message schedules or runs cache warming before the foreground send, and the parent implementation shares the model extra-parameter mapping with the warming request.
facets.exit_state: Each warming request receives max_tokens=1 through a local kwargs copy, the model extra_params mapping remains unchanged for foreground and prefill-capable calls, and the length-continuation path is no longer forced into one-token responses by cache warming.

candidate_pool.title: Serialize turns that target the same persisted conversation across process boundaries.
candidate_pool.summary: Add a durable per-conversation admission protocol in the shared state database so independent runtimes can coordinate ownership of a turn.

candidate_pool.title: Bound each cache-warming provider request to one output token without permanently reducing the normal completion budget or triggering repeated one-token prefill continuations.
candidate_pool.summary: Create request-local cache-warming kwargs before applying the one-token maintenance cap, preserving the model's configured parameters for subsequent foreground and prefill completions.

facets.module_role: Request-parameter isolation at the boundary between background cache maintenance and foreground model completion.

candidate_pool.title: Make deferred-resource preloading an explicit, mode-aware session budget policy.
candidate_pool.summary: Expose a session-start deferred-tool preload percentage, carry it from user settings into core configuration, default it to 10, and disable the policy in CLI bare/safe modes.

candidate_pool.title: Keep the context breakdown's messages attribution aligned with the active session instead of subtracting another session's cache hit.
candidate_pool.summary: Make context aggregation prefer the active session's cached-content count while retaining a compatibility fallback when no usable chat-local value exists.

candidate_pool.title: Keep active tool, code, file, or similar payloads usable while removing empty text artifacts that can trigger request validation failures.
candidate_pool.summary: Normalize outgoing content parts so an empty text field cannot invalidate a payload-bearing part or remain as a truly empty text-only part.

candidate_pool.title: Remove a stale materialized default from existing configuration files so the new policy takes effect after upgrade without clobbering user-selected resource budgets.
candidate_pool.summary: Migrate configurations that persisted the temporary 256000 default so they inherit the new ratio-only default, without rewriting an intentional cap or explicit null.

facets.module_role: Versioned configuration migration and user-choice preservation

candidate_pool.summary: Resolve concurrent work coordination through a contract-first, evidence-validated change chain.

candidate_pool.title: Serialize turns that target the same persisted conversation across process boundaries.
candidate_pool.summary: Add a durable per-conversation admission protocol in the shared state database so independent runtimes can coordinate ownership of a turn.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent a long-running turn from expiring into a concurrent successor and prevent late cleanup from releasing a successor's lease.
candidate_pool.summary: Keep the lease alive through long model/tool/compression work and release it safely on every exit path.

candidate_pool.title: Avoid spending correction-model work on an invalid edit request and make the repair precondition explicit.
candidate_pool.summary: Reject a blank or whitespace-only edit search string before the expensive LLM correction path is invoked and return a localized instruction to reread the target before retrying.

candidate_pool.title: Provide a profile/home discriminator for mutable terminal state when one process serves multiple routed scopes.
candidate_pool.summary: Derive a stable namespace component from the active routed profile/home context, with an empty result when no routed override is active so legacy identity remains intact.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent a compression-created child session from bypassing the lease held for the logical conversation while avoiding serialization of unrelated delegated work.
candidate_pool.summary: Use the compression-lineage root as the lease domain while keeping delegate and explicit branch sessions independent.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent side effects and post-execution hooks for prepared tool calls after a later preflight abort while preserving one explicit aborted outcome for each recorded call.
candidate_pool.summary: Recheck cancellation when a prepared parallel-call entry is finally invoked. If the batch was aborted after preflight, convert that recorded entry into an error outcome and execution-end event so the existing ordered path can persist a corresponding tool result without starting the side effect or post-execution hook.

facets.module_role: Abort-aware deferred executor for a parallel tool-call batch

candidate_pool.title: Prevent cancelled in-flight tool turns from persisting as transcript state and avoid unnecessary follow-up work.
candidate_pool.summary: When every model-initiated tool in an interactive turn is cancelled, restore the conversation to the checkpoint taken before the current query instead of recording cancellation responses as a new user turn or sending another request.

candidate_pool.title: parallel-preflight-abort-reconciliation
candidate_pool.summary: When sequential preflight of a concurrent tool batch aborts the run after a call has been prepared, reconcile the already-recorded deferred entry into a standardized aborted result before returning the batch.

facets.entry_state: An assistant message contains multiple tool calls; preflight is sequential, at least one call is prepared for deferred parallel execution, and a later preflight aborts the shared run.
facets.exit_state: All recorded calls have tool_execution_end error outcomes and source-ordered toolResult messages, with no prepared tool execution or post-execution result hook after the abort.

candidate_pool.summary: Create request-local cache-warming kwargs before applying the one-token maintenance cap, preserving the model's configured parameters for subsequent foreground and prefill completions.

facets.module_role: Request-parameter isolation at the boundary between background cache maintenance and foreground model completion.

candidate_pool.title: Restore a gateway-driven session on a coherent current provider/endpoint/wire route and remove the stale-provider 404 caused by recombining fields from different route snapshots.
candidate_pool.summary: Align the Desktop/TUI stored-session adapter with the canonical route resolver so the current model is restored with the route that last served it instead of being paired with the first-call billing provider.

candidate_pool.title: Make a failed localized edit actionable by distinguishing an exact-match miss and directing the agent to inspect current content.
candidate_pool.summary: Replace vague no-occurrence edit feedback with exact-match guidance that points the agent to current file content before retrying.

candidate_pool.title: Detect regressions in provider, endpoint, and wire-mode precedence during Desktop/TUI and CLI session restoration.
candidate_pool.summary: Add focused stored-row tests that make cross-surface route precedence observable and prevent future recombination of a current model with an older provider or endpoint.

candidate_pool.title: Make retry guidance visible at the current context boundary without invalidating or expanding the stable system-instruction prefix.
candidate_pool.summary: Place invalid-stream retry guidance at the end of request contents while preserving API role ordering and hook modifications, instead of mutating the stable system instruction.

candidate_pool.title: Keep a stored provider, endpoint, and wire mode coherent when top-level session metadata contains endpoint information but omits its provider.
candidate_pool.summary: Complete the shared persisted-session route contract for legacy top-level route metadata without changing nested-route precedence or treating a bare billing bucket as a provider identity.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent an MCP-discovery-only configuration from spawning an unused LSP runtime when the parent ACP process has opted into LSP.
candidate_pool.summary: Apply a local capability override when building the secondary MCP discovery configuration so an LSP opt-in inherited from the parent ACP runtime cannot start an unused LSP stack.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent a long-running turn from expiring into a concurrent successor and prevent late cleanup from releasing a successor's lease.
candidate_pool.summary: Keep the lease alive through long model/tool/compression work and release it safely on every exit path.

candidate_pool.title: Avoid spending correction-model work on an invalid edit request and make the repair precondition explicit.
candidate_pool.summary: Reject a blank or whitespace-only edit search string before the expensive LLM correction path is invoked and return a localized instruction to reread the target before retrying.

candidate_pool.title: Provide a profile/home discriminator for mutable terminal state when one process serves multiple routed scopes.
candidate_pool.summary: Derive a stable namespace component from the active routed profile/home context, with an empty result when no routed override is active so legacy identity remains intact.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent a compression-created child session from bypassing the lease held for the logical conversation while avoiding serialization of unrelated delegated work.
candidate_pool.summary: Use the compression-lineage root as the lease domain while keeping delegate and explicit branch sessions independent.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent side effects and post-execution hooks for prepared tool calls after a later preflight abort while preserving one explicit aborted outcome for each recorded call.
candidate_pool.summary: Recheck cancellation when a prepared parallel-call entry is finally invoked. If the batch was aborted after preflight, convert that recorded entry into an error outcome and execution-end event so the existing ordered path can persist a corresponding tool result without starting the side effect or post-execution hook.

facets.module_role: Abort-aware deferred executor for a parallel tool-call batch

candidate_pool.title: Prevent cancelled in-flight tool turns from persisting as transcript state and avoid unnecessary follow-up work.
candidate_pool.summary: When every model-initiated tool in an interactive turn is cancelled, restore the conversation to the checkpoint taken before the current query instead of recording cancellation responses as a new user turn or sending another request.

candidate_pool.title: parallel-preflight-abort-reconciliation
candidate_pool.summary: When sequential preflight of a concurrent tool batch aborts the run after a call has been prepared, reconcile the already-recorded deferred entry into a standardized aborted result before returning the batch.

facets.entry_state: An assistant message contains multiple tool calls; preflight is sequential, at least one call is prepared for deferred parallel execution, and a later preflight aborts the shared run.
facets.exit_state: All recorded calls have tool_execution_end error outcomes and source-ordered toolResult messages, with no prepared tool execution or post-execution result hook after the abort.

candidate_pool.title: Remove silent post-tool turns while bounding automatic recovery work.
candidate_pool.summary: Recover an interactive continuation that follows tool execution but ends without visible text by issuing a bounded recovery nudge through the normal continuation path.

candidate_pool.title: Bound each cache-warming provider request to one output token without permanently reducing the normal completion budget or triggering repeated one-token prefill continuations.
candidate_pool.summary: Create request-local cache-warming kwargs before applying the one-token maintenance cap, preserving the model's configured parameters for subsequent foreground and prefill completions.

facets.module_role: Request-parameter isolation at the boundary between background cache maintenance and foreground model completion.

candidate_pool.title: Restore a gateway-driven session on a coherent current provider/endpoint/wire route and remove the stale-provider 404 caused by recombining fields from different route snapshots.
candidate_pool.summary: Align the Desktop/TUI stored-session adapter with the canonical route resolver so the current model is restored with the route that last served it instead of being paired with the first-call billing provider.

candidate_pool.title: Make a failed localized edit actionable by distinguishing an exact-match miss and directing the agent to inspect current content.
candidate_pool.summary: Replace vague no-occurrence edit feedback with exact-match guidance that points the agent to current file content before retrying.

candidate_pool.title: Detect regressions in provider, endpoint, and wire-mode precedence during Desktop/TUI and CLI session restoration.
candidate_pool.summary: Add focused stored-row tests that make cross-surface route precedence observable and prevent future recombination of a current model with an older provider or endpoint.

candidate_pool.title: Make retry guidance visible at the current context boundary without invalidating or expanding the stable system-instruction prefix.
candidate_pool.summary: Place invalid-stream retry guidance at the end of request contents while preserving API role ordering and hook modifications, instead of mutating the stable system instruction.

candidate_pool.title: Keep a stored provider, endpoint, and wire mode coherent when top-level session metadata contains endpoint information but omits its provider.
candidate_pool.summary: Complete the shared persisted-session route contract for legacy top-level route metadata without changing nested-route precedence or treating a bare billing bucket as a provider identity.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent an MCP-discovery-only configuration from spawning an unused LSP runtime when the parent ACP process has opted into LSP.
candidate_pool.summary: Apply a local capability override when building the secondary MCP discovery configuration so an LSP opt-in inherited from the parent ACP runtime cannot start an unused LSP stack.

candidate_pool.title: routed_profile_terminal_isolation
candidate_pool.summary: Establish one reusable routed-scope namespace and apply it to the two mutable terminal state boundaries implicated by the collision: session-isolated environment identities and session cwd records.

facets.entry_state: One process serves routed profiles A and B; identical opening messages can produce the same raw session id, and raw per-session environment and cwd state are profile-blind.
facets.exit_state: The same raw id resolves to distinct environment identities and independent cwd slots under different routed profiles; no-override behavior remains raw and persistent-Docker profile scoping remains stable.

candidate_pool.title: reconstruct-session-scoped-cached-token-state
candidate_pool.summary: Resolve the daemon accounting defect by establishing chat-local cached usage, synchronizing and invalidating it with prompt state, preserving it through route and rescue recovery, routing context aggregation through the active chat, and locking the invariant with focused regressions.

facets.entry_state: A multi-session daemon has an active chat with total prompt usage 65,267 while the process-global singleton may contain a foreign cached count of 64,653; the chat also lacks a reliable cached state across token-state transitions.
facets.exit_state: The active chat owns the latest usable cached count or an explicit zero, route and recovery transitions preserve or clear it with the associated prompt state, collectContextData uses that session-owned value including zero, and the foreign global value cannot collapse the messages row.

candidate_pool.title: scope-inherited-capabilities-for-secondary-discovery-runtime
candidate_pool.summary: At the secondary workspace MCP configuration boundary, preserve the parent runtime arguments needed for discovery but explicitly disable the unrelated LSP capability, then let the existing MCP initialization and test oracle validate the resulting configuration.

facets.entry_state: An ACP process is constructing a workspace MCP discovery Config from parent arguments that may contain an LSP opt-in.
facets.exit_state: The workspace discovery Config is resolved with LSP disabled, MCP discovery proceeds through its manager, and the parent ACP configuration is not changed.

candidate_pool.summary: Namespace the alias-resolved task identity used for a session-isolated sandbox by the active routed profile/home, preventing same-fingerprint profiles from sharing an environment cache slot while preserving subagent aliasing and legacy raw behavior.

candidate_pool.title: Detect regressions in provider, endpoint, and wire-mode precedence during Desktop/TUI and CLI session restoration.
candidate_pool.summary: Add focused stored-row tests that make cross-surface route precedence observable and prevent future recombination of a current model with an older provider or endpoint.

candidate_pool.title: Give each session an authoritative cached-content count associated with the same chat that owns its prompt total.
candidate_pool.summary: Materialize cached-content token usage as first-class state on each chat/session and expose it through a route-aware accessor, rather than making the process-global last-writer value the only source.

candidate_pool.title: Remove an unintended fixed token ceiling that makes compression fire at a non-proportional point across heterogeneous context windows, while preserving an explicit user-controlled absolute cost ceiling.
candidate_pool.summary: Make the absolute compression-trigger cap opt-in by changing the canonical default and its seeded template from 256000 to null/None, while retaining explicit positive caps as lower-of ratio-versus-absolute controls.

facets.module_role: Compression budget policy and configuration defaulting

candidate_pool.summary: Establish one reusable routed-scope namespace and apply it to the two mutable terminal state boundaries implicated by the collision: session-isolated environment identities and session cwd records.

facets.entry_state: One process serves routed profiles A and B; identical opening messages can produce the same raw session id, and raw per-session environment and cwd state are profile-blind.
facets.exit_state: The same raw id resolves to distinct environment identities and independent cwd slots under different routed profiles; no-override behavior remains raw and persistent-Docker profile scoping remains stable.

candidate_pool.title: reconstruct-session-scoped-cached-token-state
candidate_pool.summary: Resolve the daemon accounting defect by establishing chat-local cached usage, synchronizing and invalidating it with prompt state, preserving it through route and rescue recovery, routing context aggregation through the active chat, and locking the invariant with focused regressions.

facets.entry_state: A multi-session daemon has an active chat with total prompt usage 65,267 while the process-global singleton may contain a foreign cached count of 64,653; the chat also lacks a reliable cached state across token-state transitions.
facets.exit_state: The active chat owns the latest usable cached count or an explicit zero, route and recovery transitions preserve or clear it with the associated prompt state, collectContextData uses that session-owned value including zero, and the foreign global value cannot collapse the messages row.

candidate_pool.title: scope-inherited-capabilities-for-secondary-discovery-runtime
candidate_pool.summary: At the secondary workspace MCP configuration boundary, preserve the parent runtime arguments needed for discovery but explicitly disable the unrelated LSP capability, then let the existing MCP initialization and test oracle validate the resulting configuration.

facets.entry_state: An ACP process is constructing a workspace MCP discovery Config from parent arguments that may contain an LSP opt-in.
facets.exit_state: The workspace discovery Config is resolved with LSP disabled, MCP discovery proceeds through its manager, and the parent ACP configuration is not changed.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent a compression-created child session from bypassing the lease held for the logical conversation while avoiding serialization of unrelated delegated work.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent side effects and post-execution hooks for prepared tool calls after a later preflight abort while preserving one explicit aborted outcome for each recorded call.

facets.entry_state: The session has completed one or more model-initiated tool calls and is about to process the next model stream.
facets.exit_state: The model emits visible text after the recovery request or the session follows its normal completion/failure path.

candidate_pool.title: preserve_startup_session_context_in_late_bound_main_model_input
candidate_pool.summary: Partition the hardened context so a final startup session-context request remains pending, then verify that the pending segment is the content passed through the main-model API override.

facets.entry_state: Context management receives a pending HistoryTurn whose text begins with <session_context>; graph mapping gives it the stable environment-context turn identity, and the old boundary classifier can exclude that identity from the pending segment.
facets.exit_state: The final startup request is present in pendingApiHistory as one content item, and the client can construct apiHistoryOverride from historical API content plus that pending item while earlier startup context remains historical.

candidate_pool.summary: Recover an interactive continuation that follows tool execution but ends without visible text by issuing a bounded recovery nudge through the normal continuation path.

facets.module_role: Request-parameter isolation at the boundary between background cache maintenance and foreground model completion.

candidate_pool.title: Provide a reproducible oracle that detects stale or version-misaligned generated protocol artifacts after a Rust schema-definition change.
candidate_pool.summary: Regenerate the checked-in app-server TypeScript/JSON schema artifacts after changing the Rust type export and compare the resulting fixture tree with the repository's committed schema output.

candidate_pool.title: local_unix_stdio_descriptor_lifecycle
candidate_pool.summary: At the local stdio extension-process boundary, apply the Unix-only descriptor guard and then validate that the server tree receives only transport stdio without regressing communication, launch compatibility, parent ownership, or failure reporting.

facets.entry_state: A local stdio server is launched with the shared command's default inherited-descriptor policy, so unrelated inheritable descriptors may enter the server process tree and the regression boundary is not covered by an end-to-end oracle.
facets.exit_state: The local Unix launch path enforces stdio-only descriptor inheritance, server and descendant probes report no unrelated sentinels, and the integration oracle confirms MCP communication, launch variants, arguments, environment, cwd, parent descriptor ownership, and exec-failure reporting.

candidate_pool.title: serialize_persistent_conversation_turn_across_processes
candidate_pool.summary: Coordinate a persisted conversation across independent runtimes by establishing a durable lease domain, optionally collapsing compression descendants onto the lineage root, admitting only after lease acquisition and durable reload, and maintaining ownership until turn completion and flush.

facets.entry_state: Two or more requests can target an existing persisted session from different processes, each with a potentially stale history snapshot and no shared process-local lock.
facets.exit_state: One admitted turn owns the durable conversation lease through history load, model/tool/compression work, and flush; a later turn acquires after release or valid expiry, reloads the current tip, and stale cleanup cannot release a successor lease.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent unrelated parent file descriptors from leaking into a local stdio extension process tree while preserving the explicit transport stdio.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent side effects and post-execution hooks for prepared tool calls after a later preflight abort while preserving one explicit aborted outcome for each recorded call.
candidate_pool.summary: Recheck cancellation when a prepared parallel-call entry is finally invoked. If the batch was aborted after preflight, convert that recorded entry into an error outcome and execution-end event so the existing ordered path can persist a corresponding tool result without starting the side effect or post-execution hook.

facets.module_role: Abort-aware deferred executor for a parallel tool-call batch

candidate_pool.title: Prevent cancelled in-flight tool turns from persisting as transcript state and avoid unnecessary follow-up work.
candidate_pool.summary: When every model-initiated tool in an interactive turn is cancelled, restore the conversation to the checkpoint taken before the current query instead of recording cancellation responses as a new user turn or sending another request.

candidate_pool.title: Provide cause-accurate user guidance when persistence is refused because another process is compressing the session.
candidate_pool.summary: Keep active compression-lease refusal distinct from ordinary SQLite write-lock contention so recovery guidance names the actual transient cause. This is an implementation-bearing ancillary change co-committed with the turn-serialization fix.

facets.module_role: Persistence failure classification and turn-completion explanation

candidate_pool.title: interactive-tool-turn-bounding
candidate_pool.summary: The interactive path has two event-dependent recovery branches: remove a cancelled tool turn from durable history, or recover a silent successful tool continuation with a bounded nudge.

facets.entry_state: A user query is being processed; the model may request tools, produce an empty continuation, or have all requested tools cancelled.
facets.exit_state: Cancelled turns are absent from durable history, or a post-tool continuation produces visible completion or stops after the automatic-nudge budget.

candidate_pool.title: parallel-preflight-abort-reconciliation
candidate_pool.summary: When sequential preflight of a concurrent tool batch aborts the run after a call has been prepared, reconcile the already-recorded deferred entry into a standardized aborted result before returning the batch.

facets.entry_state: An assistant message contains multiple tool calls; preflight is sequential, at least one call is prepared for deferred parallel execution, and a later preflight aborts the shared run.
facets.exit_state: All recorded calls have tool_execution_end error outcomes and source-ordered toolResult messages, with no prepared tool execution or post-execution result hook after the abort.

candidate_pool.title: Provide a profile/home discriminator for mutable terminal state when one process serves multiple routed scopes.
candidate_pool.summary: Derive a stable namespace component from the active routed profile/home context, with an empty result when no routed override is active so legacy identity remains intact.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent unrelated parent file descriptors from leaking into a local stdio extension process tree while preserving the explicit transport stdio.
candidate_pool.summary: Configure the local Unix stdio extension-process launch so unrelated descriptors inherited by the orchestrator do not cross into the extension server or its descendants, while the explicit stdio transport and existing launch settings remain usable.

cases.query: Make internal state transitions, failures, progress, accounting, and validation results observable and truthful enough for operators and callers. identify-observable-contract emit-at-owner-boundary preserve-correlation-and-accounting avoid-false-success-or-silent-loss validate-success-failure-and-replay-observations

candidate_pool.title: Make the restrictive multi-hook permission contract executable as a regression check.
candidate_pool.summary: Add a focused regression oracle for the structured permission aggregation contract and its compatibility boundary.

candidate_pool.title: Make a failed localized edit actionable by distinguishing an exact-match miss and directing the agent to inspect current content.
candidate_pool.summary: Replace vague no-occurrence edit feedback with exact-match guidance that points the agent to current file content before retrying.

candidate_pool.title: Detect regressions in provider, endpoint, and wire-mode precedence during Desktop/TUI and CLI session restoration.
candidate_pool.summary: Add focused stored-row tests that make cross-surface route precedence observable and prevent future recombination of a current model with an older provider or endpoint.

candidate_pool.title: Turn the otherwise silent state-continuity and cross-session attribution failures into directly observable test failures.
candidate_pool.summary: Add executable regression oracles for cross-session cache leakage, zero-value nullish selection, route retention, state invalidation, and failed-rescue restoration.

candidate_pool.title: edit-request-budget-guard
candidate_pool.summary: The edit path handles two predicate-dependent failures: reject blank selectors before correction-model work, or return exact-match guidance for nonblank selectors that do not match current content.

facets.entry_state: An edit invocation supplies either a blank search string or a nonblank string with zero matches.
facets.exit_state: Blank input fails before LLM correction, or a no-match error tells the agent to reread current target lines and retry with an exact match.

candidate_pool.title: coherent_gateway_route_restore
candidate_pool.summary: Establish one canonical persisted-route precedence contract, make Desktop/TUI resume consume it, and validate that a session's current model is restored with the latest coherent provider/endpoint/wire route.

facets.entry_state: A gateway-written row has a current model and nested gateway_runtime route, while billing_provider may still describe the first accounted route; the Desktop/TUI reader ignores the nested route and can select an incompatible provider or endpoint.
facets.exit_state: The shared reader defines nested-route, top-level-route, and billing fallback precedence; Desktop/TUI and CLI consume compatible route data; focused tests prove nested-route restoration and stale-top-level rejection.

candidate_pool.title: Resolve observable validation and diagnostics through a contract-first, evidence-validated change chain.
candidate_pool.summary: Resolve observable validation and diagnostics through a contract-first, evidence-validated change chain.

candidate_pool.title: Serialize turns that target the same persisted conversation across process boundaries.
candidate_pool.summary: Add a durable per-conversation admission protocol in the shared state database so independent runtimes can coordinate ownership of a turn.

candidate_pool.title: Make deferred-resource preloading an explicit, mode-aware session budget policy.
candidate_pool.summary: Expose a session-start deferred-tool preload percentage, carry it from user settings into core configuration, default it to 10, and disable the policy in CLI bare/safe modes.

candidate_pool.title: Stop retrying an exhausted model when the upstream supplies no retry schedule, so persistent fallback handling can be reached.
candidate_pool.summary: Add a classifier rule that maps structured model-capacity exhaustion with no server delay to terminal handling, while preserving retryable handling for capacity failures that carry a server delay.

facets.module_role: Structured upstream-failure classifier at the retry and fallback boundary

facets.module_role: Unix local stdio launch integration oracle

candidate_pool.summary: Add an executable regression oracle for descriptor isolation and for the compatibility behaviors that must survive the new process boundary.

facets.module_role: Unix local stdio launch integration oracle

candidate_pool.title: Keep active tool, code, file, or similar payloads usable while removing empty text artifacts that can trigger request validation failures.
candidate_pool.summary: Normalize outgoing content parts so an empty text field cannot invalidate a payload-bearing part or remain as a truly empty text-only part.

candidate_pool.title: Provide a reproducible oracle that detects stale or version-misaligned generated protocol artifacts after a Rust schema-definition change.
candidate_pool.summary: Regenerate the checked-in app-server TypeScript/JSON schema artifacts after changing the Rust type export and compare the resulting fixture tree with the repository's committed schema output.

candidate_pool.title: Apply the resource decision at the stable startup boundary so preloaded schemas are declared initially and are not later reintroduced as deferred reminders.
candidate_pool.summary: Run the budgeted reveal after registry warm/resume handling and before deferred-reminder construction so the initial declaration list and reminder reflect the same revealed state without introducing a mid-session preload mutation.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent concurrent requests from running against the same stale transcript snapshot and losing or interleaving their user/assistant exchanges.
candidate_pool.summary: Guard an existing persistent turn with the durable lease and replace its caller snapshot with the latest committed conversation after admission.

facets.module_role: Persistent turn admission and state reconciliation

candidate_pool.title: Remove an unintended fixed token ceiling that makes compression fire at a non-proportional point across heterogeneous context windows, while preserving an explicit user-controlled absolute cost ceiling.
candidate_pool.summary: Make the absolute compression-trigger cap opt-in by changing the canonical default and its seeded template from 256000 to null/None, while retaining explicit positive caps as lower-of ratio-versus-absolute controls.

facets.module_role: Compression budget policy and configuration defaulting

candidate_pool.title: Preserve the strongest safety-relevant permission outcome when multiple structured hook results contribute to one tool-execution gate.
candidate_pool.summary: Make the structured permission verdict from multiple matching PreToolUse hooks severity-aware so aggregation cannot weaken a restrictive result because of input or configuration order; retain reason information only from the winning rank, joining equal-rank reasons.

candidate_pool.title: Provide a profile/home discriminator for mutable terminal state when one process serves multiple routed scopes.
candidate_pool.summary: Derive a stable namespace component from the active routed profile/home context, with an empty result when no routed override is active so legacy identity remains intact.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent unrelated parent file descriptors from leaking into a local stdio extension process tree while preserving the explicit transport stdio.
candidate_pool.summary: Configure the local Unix stdio extension-process launch so unrelated descriptors inherited by the orchestrator do not cross into the extension server or its descendants, while the explicit stdio transport and existing launch settings remain usable.

cases.query: Adapt an external provider, protocol, backend, or capability dialect without leaking incompatible assumptions into the common runtime. discover-external-contract normalize-capabilities-and-identifiers adapt-request-and-response map-provider-specific-failure validate-capability-and-compatibility-matrix

candidate_pool.title: Resolve provider interface adaptation through a contract-first, evidence-validated change chain.
candidate_pool.summary: Resolve provider interface adaptation through a contract-first, evidence-validated change chain.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent out-of-range percentage input from turning a bounded preload budget into an oversized or effectively unconditional preload.
candidate_pool.summary: Defend the percentage invariant at both the declarative settings boundary and runtime so a hand-edited value above 100 cannot allocate a budget larger than the full context window.

candidate_pool.title: Restore a gateway-driven session on a coherent current provider/endpoint/wire route and remove the stale-provider 404 caused by recombining fields from different route snapshots.
candidate_pool.summary: Align the Desktop/TUI stored-session adapter with the canonical route resolver so the current model is restored with the route that last served it instead of being paired with the first-call billing provider.

candidate_pool.title: Keep a stored provider, endpoint, and wire mode coherent when top-level session metadata contains endpoint information but omits its provider.
candidate_pool.summary: Complete the shared persisted-session route contract for legacy top-level route metadata without changing nested-route precedence or treating a bare billing bucket as a provider identity.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent an MCP-discovery-only configuration from spawning an unused LSP runtime when the parent ACP process has opted into LSP.
candidate_pool.summary: Apply a local capability override when building the secondary MCP discovery configuration so an LSP opt-in inherited from the parent ACP runtime cannot start an unused LSP stack.

candidate_pool.title: Make v2 web-search action payloads parseable and observable with the same discriminator and nullability contract used by the v2 producer, preventing page-open actions from falling through to an incompatible unknown/`other` interpretation.
candidate_pool.summary: Make the generated v2 client contract for web-search actions version-specific and bind `ThreadItem.action` to it, so the client-facing representation matches the v2 producer instead of the root/v1 representation.

facets.module_role: versioned app-server protocol schema generation and aggregate-type binding

candidate_pool.title: coherent_gateway_route_restore
candidate_pool.summary: Establish one canonical persisted-route precedence contract, make Desktop/TUI resume consume it, and validate that a session's current model is restored with the latest coherent provider/endpoint/wire route.

facets.entry_state: A gateway-written row has a current model and nested gateway_runtime route, while billing_provider may still describe the first accounted route; the Desktop/TUI reader ignores the nested route and can select an incompatible provider or endpoint.
facets.exit_state: The shared reader defines nested-route, top-level-route, and billing fallback precedence; Desktop/TUI and CLI consume compatible route data; focused tests prove nested-route restoration and stale-top-level rejection.

candidate_pool.title: scope-inherited-capabilities-for-secondary-discovery-runtime
candidate_pool.summary: At the secondary workspace MCP configuration boundary, preserve the parent runtime arguments needed for discovery but explicitly disable the unrelated LSP capability, then let the existing MCP initialization and test oracle validate the resulting configuration.

facets.entry_state: An ACP process is constructing a workspace MCP discovery Config from parent arguments that may contain an LSP opt-in.
facets.exit_state: The workspace discovery Config is resolved with LSP disabled, MCP discovery proceeds through its manager, and the parent ACP configuration is not changed.

candidate_pool.title: Resolve effect control and isolation through a contract-first, evidence-validated change chain.
candidate_pool.summary: Resolve effect control and isolation through a contract-first, evidence-validated change chain.

candidate_pool.summary: Create request-local cache-warming kwargs before applying the one-token maintenance cap, preserving the model's configured parameters for subsequent foreground and prefill completions.

facets.module_role: Request-parameter isolation at the boundary between background cache maintenance and foreground model completion.

candidate_pool.title: Stop retrying an exhausted model when the upstream supplies no retry schedule, so persistent fallback handling can be reached.

facets.module_role: Structured upstream-failure classifier at the retry and fallback boundary

candidate_pool.title: Remove a stale materialized default from existing configuration files so the new policy takes effect after upgrade without clobbering user-selected resource budgets.

facets.module_role: Versioned configuration migration and user-choice preservation

candidate_pool.title: Translate a percentage resource policy into a concrete token budget before deferred-resource reconciliation.
candidate_pool.summary: Convert an accepted positive threshold and available model capacity into a floored token budget at session start, using the configured context window or model-limit fallback and skipping unsupported branches.

candidate_pool.title: Make retry guidance visible at the current context boundary without invalidating or expanding the stable system-instruction prefix.
candidate_pool.summary: Place invalid-stream retry guidance at the end of request contents while preserving API role ordering and hook modifications, instead of mutating the stable system instruction.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent unrelated parent file descriptors from leaking into a local stdio extension process tree while preserving the explicit transport stdio.
candidate_pool.summary: Configure the local Unix stdio extension-process launch so unrelated descriptors inherited by the orchestrator do not cross into the extension server or its descendants, while the explicit stdio transport and existing launch settings remain usable.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent side effects and post-execution hooks for prepared tool calls after a later preflight abort while preserving one explicit aborted outcome for each recorded call.
candidate_pool.summary: Recheck cancellation when a prepared parallel-call entry is finally invoked. If the batch was aborted after preflight, convert that recorded entry into an error outcome and execution-end event so the existing ordered path can persist a corresponding tool result without starting the side effect or post-execution hook.

facets.module_role: Abort-aware deferred executor for a parallel tool-call batch

candidate_pool.title: restore_proportional_compression_budget_and_upgrade_stale_configs
candidate_pool.summary: Establish the ratio-driven default for compression triggers, then reconcile versioned configurations that persisted the temporary 256000 default; leave explicit absolute caps available as an opt-in branch and verify the existing cache/live-session consumers follow the canonical value.

facets.entry_state: The parent v46 policy supplies a 256000 cap when threshold_tokens is absent, templates can persist that value, and a large-window session can compact at the fixed cap instead of its proportional trigger.
facets.exit_state: The v47 default and template represent no absolute cap, fresh and live configurations treat absence as ratio-only, versioned old literals are removed, and explicit positive caps still clamp triggers and survive model switches.

facets.module_role: Request-parameter isolation at the boundary between background cache maintenance and foreground model completion.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent a tool-execution path from terminating without a user-facing explanation when the first post-tool response is empty.
candidate_pool.summary: In the session execution loop, recover from an empty response immediately following completed tool calls by sending a dedicated nudge before allowing normal completion.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent a long-running turn from expiring into a concurrent successor and prevent late cleanup from releasing a successor's lease.
candidate_pool.summary: Keep the lease alive through long model/tool/compression work and release it safely on every exit path.

candidate_pool.title: Keep the context breakdown's messages attribution aligned with the active session instead of subtracting another session's cache hit.
candidate_pool.summary: Make context aggregation prefer the active session's cached-content count while retaining a compatibility fallback when no usable chat-local value exists.

candidate_pool.title: Restore a gateway-driven session on a coherent current provider/endpoint/wire route and remove the stale-provider 404 caused by recombining fields from different route snapshots.
candidate_pool.summary: Align the Desktop/TUI stored-session adapter with the canonical route resolver so the current model is restored with the route that last served it instead of being paired with the first-call billing provider.

candidate_pool.title: Apply the resource decision at the stable startup boundary so preloaded schemas are declared initially and are not later reintroduced as deferred reminders.
candidate_pool.summary: Run the budgeted reveal after registry warm/resume handling and before deferred-reminder construction so the initial declaration list and reminder reflect the same revealed state without introducing a mid-session preload mutation.

candidate_pool.title: Remove an unintended fixed token ceiling that makes compression fire at a non-proportional point across heterogeneous context windows, while preserving an explicit user-controlled absolute cost ceiling.
candidate_pool.summary: Make the absolute compression-trigger cap opt-in by changing the canonical default and its seeded template from 256000 to null/None, while retaining explicit positive caps as lower-of ratio-versus-absolute controls.

facets.module_role: Compression budget policy and configuration defaulting

candidate_pool.title: Keep a stored provider, endpoint, and wire mode coherent when top-level session metadata contains endpoint information but omits its provider.
candidate_pool.summary: Complete the shared persisted-session route contract for legacy top-level route metadata without changing nested-route precedence or treating a bare billing bucket as a provider identity.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent a compression-created child session from bypassing the lease held for the logical conversation while avoiding serialization of unrelated delegated work.
candidate_pool.summary: Use the compression-lineage root as the lease domain while keeping delegate and explicit branch sessions independent.

cases.query: Keep structured requests, arguments, results, identities, and completion events valid and paired across producer/consumer boundaries. locate-contract-boundary normalize-or-validate-structure preserve-identity-and-pairing classify-malformed-or-partial-input validate-positive-negative-and-replay-cases

candidate_pool.title: Serialize turns that target the same persisted conversation across process boundaries.
candidate_pool.summary: Add a durable per-conversation admission protocol in the shared state database so independent runtimes can coordinate ownership of a turn.

candidate_pool.title: Make the restrictive multi-hook permission contract executable as a regression check.
candidate_pool.summary: Add a focused regression oracle for the structured permission aggregation contract and its compatibility boundary.

candidate_pool.title: Keep active tool, code, file, or similar payloads usable while removing empty text artifacts that can trigger request validation failures.
candidate_pool.summary: Normalize outgoing content parts so an empty text field cannot invalidate a payload-bearing part or remain as a truly empty text-only part.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent concurrent requests from running against the same stale transcript snapshot and losing or interleaving their user/assistant exchanges.
candidate_pool.summary: Guard an existing persistent turn with the durable lease and replace its caller snapshot with the latest committed conversation after admission.

facets.module_role: Persistent turn admission and state reconciliation

candidate_pool.title: Preserve the strongest safety-relevant permission outcome when multiple structured hook results contribute to one tool-execution gate.
candidate_pool.summary: Make the structured permission verdict from multiple matching PreToolUse hooks severity-aware so aggregation cannot weaken a restrictive result because of input or configuration order; retain reason information only from the winning rank, joining equal-rank reasons.

candidate_pool.title: serialize_persistent_conversation_turn_across_processes
candidate_pool.summary: Coordinate a persisted conversation across independent runtimes by establishing a durable lease domain, optionally collapsing compression descendants onto the lineage root, admitting only after lease acquisition and durable reload, and maintaining ownership until turn completion and flush.

facets.entry_state: Two or more requests can target an existing persisted session from different processes, each with a potentially stale history snapshot and no shared process-local lock.
facets.exit_state: One admitted turn owns the durable conversation lease through history load, model/tool/compression work, and flush; a later turn acquires after release or valid expiry, reloads the current tip, and stale cleanup cannot release a successor lease.

candidate_pool.title: scope-inherited-capabilities-for-secondary-discovery-runtime
candidate_pool.summary: At the secondary workspace MCP configuration boundary, preserve the parent runtime arguments needed for discovery but explicitly disable the unrelated LSP capability, then let the existing MCP initialization and test oracle validate the resulting configuration.

facets.entry_state: An ACP process is constructing a workspace MCP discovery Config from parent arguments that may contain an LSP opt-in.
facets.exit_state: The workspace discovery Config is resolved with LSP disabled, MCP discovery proceeds through its manager, and the parent ACP configuration is not changed.

candidate_pool.title: Resolve structured tool contract integrity through a contract-first, evidence-validated change chain.
candidate_pool.summary: Resolve structured tool contract integrity through a contract-first, evidence-validated change chain.

candidate_pool.title: Reconstruct the correct session-and-route cached value after a route switch or a compression rescue that mutates and then rolls back token state.
candidate_pool.summary: Carry the cached count through route retention/adoption and failed hard-rescue rollback with the rest of the route-scoped token state.

candidate_pool.title: Detect regressions that return a startup session-context request as historical content or an empty pending API segment.
candidate_pool.summary: Add a focused regression oracle for the special startup session-context boundary while retaining the existing normal late-binding split and role-alternation checks.

candidate_pool.title: Prevent cross-profile working-directory state bleed for equal raw session ids and preserve symmetric cleanup.
